Finance & Accounting (Talent Pool)

PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS) is a subsidiary of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (Chandra Asri Group) established to deliver Shared Service Center (SSC) solutions that support the Group’s growing business operation.

Our commitment is to empower Chandra Asri Group’s transformation and long-term growth by becoming a trusted strategic partner in business support and service delivery.

CASS plays a vital role in enhancing efficiency, standardizing process and driving operational excellence across the Group’s subsidiaries-including entities based in Singapore.

Available Finance Positions:

ERA (Energy & Risk Accounting) Analyst

• Supports the end-to-end Energy and Risk Accounting operations, ensuring accurate stock recording, reconciliation, and valuation.
• Contributes to month-end closing, financial controls, and continuous improvement initiatives, working closely with cross-functional teams and the ERA Manager.

FP&A Analyst

• Supports Aster’s financial planning, analysis, and reporting activities.
• Ensures accurate and timely delivery of financial insights, forecasts, and performance reports to support strategic decision-making and business growth across Aster and its affiliated entities.

Treasury Analyst

• Supports Aster’s treasury operations by executing cash management activities and ensuring compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
• Plays a key part in optimizing liquidity, supporting trade finance, and enabling efficient treasury processes across Aster Group of Companies.

Tax Analyst

• Responsible for accurate execution of standard Tax activities and to ensure compliance, accuracy in tax calculation, reconciliations, and reporting as well as audit readiness within a managed services environment.
• Focuses on disciplined execution, adherence to procedures, resolves exceptions and supports statutory reporting and close activities.

Accounting Analyst

• Responsible for accurate execution of standard Tax activities and to ensure compliance, accuracy in tax calculation, reconciliations, and reporting as well as audit readiness within a managed services environment.
• Focuses on disciplined execution, adherence to procedures, resolves exceptions and supports statutory reporting and close activities.

Controller Operations Analyst

• Support the Singapore finance team, with other business onshore stakeholders to troubleshoot AP or AR issues and process vendor invoices.
• Support and manage month end closing process.

REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree in related fields.
• Up to 7 years of experiences. ⁠
• Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
• ⁠Strong command of English.
• Experience with SAP is a plus

Important Notes

Chandra Asri is only releasing official job posting at Chandra Asri Career Site (careers.chandra-asri.com), Linkedin & Jobstreet. The Company will contact shortlisted candidate via official corporate email & phone, and will not send any hardcopy invitation for interview. Please note that the Company doesn’t ask candidates to transfer some amount of money nor cooperate with any travel agent.

BEWARE OF RECRUITMENT SCAM.
